description: Demo simulated-ERP seed: four showcase shelves. A-01/BOX-RED is the main case (ERP 12 vs 9 visible, -3). Scanning the same 9-carton fixture against the others gives an exact match (A-02/BOX-BLUE, expected 9, diff 0), an overage (A-03/BOX-GREEN, expected 6, diff +3), and a larger shortage (B-01/BOX-BLK, expected 15, diff -6).
